chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Muhammad ibn al-Nu'man Abu Ja'far al-Ahwal, from Sallam ibn al-Mustanir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

He said: Indeed, the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), when the affair between him and Talha, and al-Zubayr, and Aisha concluded at al-Basra, ascended the pulpit, praised Allah, extolled Him, and sent blessings upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), then said: O people! Indeed, the world is sweet and green, it entices people with desires and adorns them with its immediate pleasures.

And I swear by Allah that it deceives the one who hopes in it and breaks the one who wishes for it, and it will cause regret and sorrow for people due to their turning towards it, competing in it, and their jealousy and aggression against the people of religion and excellence in it through injustice, hostility, rebellion, and arrogance.

And by Allah, no people ever lived in the freshness of the dignity of Allah's bounties in the life of the world, nor constant piety in obedience to Allah and gratitude for His bounties, except that this was removed from them only after they changed themselves, turned away from obedience to Allah, committed sins, lacked vigilance, abandoned the watchfulness of Allah (Mighty and Majestic), and became complacent in gratitude for Allah's bounties.

Because Allah (Mighty and Majestic) says in the decisive part of His Book: 'Surely Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change their own condition; and when Allah intends evil to a people, there is no averting it, and besides Him they have no protector.'

And if the people of disobedience and accumulators of sins, when they feared the passing of Allah's bounties and the arrival of His anger and the change of His health, were convinced that this was from Allah (Mighty is His mention) for what their hands had earned, they would have ceased, repented, and fled to Allah (Mighty is His mention) with sincerity of intention and acknowledgment of their sins and faults, He would pardon them for every sin, and overlook every stumble, and return to them every dignity of bounty.
Then He would restore to them from the rectification of their affairs and from what He had favored them with, all that had departed from them and been spoiled.

So fear Allah, O people, with the true fear, and feel the fear of Allah (Mighty is His mention), and purify your certainty, and repent to Him from the ugliness of what the Satan incited you to, which is fighting the Wali al-Amr (Master of Command) and the People of Knowledge after the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and what you cooperated in regarding the division of the community, dispersion of affairs, and corruption of the bond of kinship.
Indeed Allah (Mighty and Majestic) accepts repentance, pardons the bad deeds, and knows what you do.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib)
key_terms.الْقِصَّةُ: The affair/event (referring to the Battle of Al-Basra)
key_terms.تَغْيِيرٌ: Change (specifically self-change leading to divine change)
key_terms.وَلِيُّ الْأَمْرِ: Master of Command (referring to the Imams)

ai.seo_question: What is the reason for the withdrawal of divine blessings according to Imam Ali's sermon in Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Delivered in Basra following the resolution of the conflict with Aisha, Talha, and Zubayr, this sermon serves as a profound theological exposition on the mechanism of divine grace and its withdrawal based on human agency. Imam Ali (as) elucidates that while the world is inherently sweet and verdant, it becomes a source of regret through human negligence and sin, explicitly linking the Quranic principle of self-change to the loss of spiritual and material blessings. The narrative concludes with a call for sincere repentance and unity, emphasizing that God’s forgiveness is accessible to those who turn back from their transgressions against the leadership of the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.hubeali: H 14816 – Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al-Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Muhammad Bin Al-No’man Abu Ja’far Al-Ahowl, from salaam Bin Al-Mustaneer, who has said the following: Abu Ja’farasws having said that:

‘Amir-ul-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, when the story in between him<sup>asws</sup> and Talha, and Al-Zubeyr, and Ayesha concluded at Al-Basra, he<sup>asws</sup> ascended the Pulpit. So he<sup>asws</sup> Praised Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and Extolled Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and sent greetings upon the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup>, then said: ‘O you people! The world is sweet and green, enchanting the people by the desires, and adorning them with its current affairs.

And I<sup>asws</sup> swear by Allah<sup>azwj</sup> that it deceives the one who hopes in it, and breaks the one who wishes for it, and there are people who would be inheriting the regret and the sorrow by advancing towards it and competing with regards to it, by their jealousies and their rebellion against the people of the religion. 
And they achieve preferences in it by injustice, and animosity, and rebellion, and ungratefulness.

By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! No people lived in the honour and dignity of the Bounties of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> in the life of the world, nor everlasting piety in obedience to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the appreciation for His<sup>azwj</sup> Bounties, and all that declined from them except after they had changed themselves, and diverted from the obedience to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and committed their sins were hardly vigilant, and ignored the Surveillance of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Majestic and Mighty, and being complacent of appreciation for the Bounties of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>,

because Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying in the Decisive (Verses) of Hisazwj Book that: “[13:11] surely Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change their own condition; and when Allah intends evil to a people, there is no averting it, and besides Him they have no protector”.

And had the people of the disobedience, and the accumulators of the sins been cautious of the decline of the Bounties of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> (for them) and their replacement by His<sup>azwj</sup> Anger and the changing of their health, been convinced that it is from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> for what their own hands have accumulated, they would have changed, and repented, and panicked to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> by the sincerity of their intentions, and acknowledgement of their sins and their offences, He<sup>azwj</sup> would Forgive all the sins and Overlook all the faults, and Return to them all the Prestigious Bounties.
Then He<sup>azwj</sup> would Correct their affairs, and from all that He<sup>azwj</sup> had Favoured them by which had declined from them and had been spoilt.

So fear Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, O you people, with the rightful fear, and feel the fear of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and be convinced with sincerity, and repent to Him<sup>azwj</sup> from the ugliness of what the Satan<sup>la</sup> has enticed you with of the fighting against ‘وَلِيِّ الْأَمْرِ وَ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ’ the Master<sup>asws</sup> of the Command (Wali Al-Amr) and the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Knowledge after the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup> and do not co-operate with those who create differences in the group, and disperse the affairs, and spoil the relationships.
Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Accept the repentance and Excuses the sins, and He<sup>azwj</sup> Knows what you are doing’.
